title: CloudTrain Site (v1)
description: Configuration of the public website served by the same web app as the platform (apps/web) and the gateway (`GET /api/public/site`). Brand, copy, differentiators, product showcase, audiences, feature blocks, FAQ, contact, footer, legal placeholders, highlighted domains, theme token overrides, feature flags and plans. The default lives in content/site.yaml; a deployment replaces it with its own file (CT_SITE_CONFIG, e.g. a ConfigMap mount) without a code change.

name.description: Product name shown in the header, titles and the footer.

legalName.description: Legal entity for the copyright line; defaults to the brand name.

logo.description: URL or absolute path of a logo image (SVG or PNG) for the header. Absent: the built-in mark.

logoDark.description: Logo variant for the dark theme; defaults to `logo`.

favicon.description: URL or absolute path of the favicon. Absent: the built-in one.

note.description: Small print under the buttons (e.g. no credit card, SSO for teams).

preview.description: The product preview beside the headline.

proof.description: Short attributes under the buttons, after the live catalog figures (e.g. `Graded on the end state`).

highlightDomains.description: Domains shown on the landing page, in this order. Each must exist in the catalog.

features.description: Secondary capability blocks on the landing page (shown after the differentiators) and reused by other pages.

howItWorks.description: Numbered steps describing how a lab works.

differentiators.description: What makes the platform different: a headline, a short explanation and an optional real screenshot each.

showcase.description: Product views on the landing page, each a real screenshot with a title, what it shows and why it matters.

why.description: One sentence on why the view matters.

audiences.description: Who the platform is for, each with its own next step.

group.description: Optional heading the question is listed under.

featured.description: Also shown in the landing page's trust section (at most six).

address.description: Postal address, one line per item.

note.description: Short text under the columns (e.g. source-available notice).

alignmentNotice.description: Shown wherever frameworks are named (footer, catalog, pricing): the platform is not affiliated with the certifying bodies, trademarks belong to their owners, no certification is conferred.

default.description: Theme for first-time visitors (the user's choice is remembered).

tokens.description: Design-token overrides per theme (CSS custom properties from apps/web/src/styles/tokens.css, e.g. `--accent`). `all` applies to every theme first.

showPricing.description: Pricing page and its navigation link.

showCatalog.description: Public read-only catalog (paths, courses, labs, exam simulations).

signupEnabled.description: Self-service sign-up. Off: calls to action lead to sign-in or contact.

showContactForm.description: Contact form on the contact page (needs a backend); off shows the contact details only.

checkoutEnabled.description: Self-service checkout for paid plans (needs the gateway's billing integration, CT_BILLING_ENABLED). Off: paid-plan calls to action lead to contact.

launch.description: Launch state of the public website. `coming-soon` renders one standalone landing (what the platform is, how pricing works, the waitlist, questions and the legal links) on every website path except the legal pages, and hides sign-in, checkout and every link into the platform. `live` renders the full website. A static build can override the mode (build-site --launch).

mode.description: coming-soon: the standalone pre-launch landing; live: the full website.

status.description: A short status line, e.g. 'Private beta, opening 2027'.

ctaLabel.description: Label of the button that scrolls to the waitlist.

points.description: What the platform is, in a few blocks.

faqGroups.description: FAQ groups shown on the coming-soon page; absent: the featured questions and the pricing group.

pricing.description: Pricing page copy around the plans.

faqGroup.description: FAQ group shown under the plans (entries of `faq` with this `group`).

model.description: How pricing works: the model in steps, copy for the compute tiers (rates come from plans.compute), worked examples and the estimator. Shown on the pricing page, the coming-soon page and, briefly, the landing page.

tiers.description: Copy for the compute tiers; the rates are plans.compute.tiers.

examples.description: Worked examples: a lab of a tier run for so many minutes; the cost is computed from plans.compute.

sessions.description: Sessions a month, for a monthly figure.

pendingNote.description: Shown where a rate would be while plans.compute is not configured.

paths.description: The ways to run CloudTrain, side by side (e.g. self-host free, hosted pay-for-compute, enterprise features by subscription or license key). Copy only; amounts come from plans.

id.description: `hosted` shows the compute rates under it.

price.description: Short price line, e.g. 'Free' or 'Per minute of compute'.

plans.description: Plans shown on the pricing page and used by billing (Stripe Products and Prices are created from them by lookup key). Three shapes: free, individual (monthly/yearly) and organisation (per seat). Learners pay for the compute their lab sessions use on top of any plan (`compute`); plans unlock premium features (`items[].features`) and early-access labs (`earlyAccess`); the free plan gives a trial lab (`free`).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code; amounts are in the currency's minor unit (cents).

placeholder.description: Every price is a placeholder, not an offer; the page says so.

free.description: The free trial: labs a free account (no payment method, no subscription) may start, uncharged, up to the caps. Everything else needs a payment method on file or a subscription.

trialLabs.description: Lab ids. Short, pod-tier labs that verify reliably.

compute.description: Pay for compute: every lab session is metered (wall-clock minutes x the tier's units per minute) and reported to a Stripe Billing Meter; a metered Price bills the units.

unitPrice.description: Price of one compute unit in minor units of `currency`, as a decimal string (Stripe unit_amount_decimal), e.g. '0.5' = half a cent.

lookupKey.description: Lookup key of the metered Price stripe:sync creates.

meterEventName.description: Event name of the Stripe Billing Meter (sum of `value`).

minimumMinutes.description: Billed minutes are rounded up; a session is billed at least this many.

placeholder.description: The rates are placeholders, not offers.

tiers.description: Compute tiers, derived from a lab's topology: pod (container nodes and virtual clusters), vm (one VM), heavy (two or more VMs, a kubeadm cluster or a netdev topology).

unitsPerMinute.description: Compute units billed per wall-clock minute of a session on this tier.
Compute units billed per wall-clock minute of a session on this tier.
Compute units billed per wall-clock minute of a session on this tier.

limits.description: Default spend caps for an individual account and an organisation.

monthlyCap.description: Default monthly compute spend cap in minor units; 0 = no cap. Accounts may change their own.

hardStop.description: At the cap, refuse new paid lab starts (running sessions are never stopped). Off: warn only.

monthlyCap.description: Default monthly compute spend cap in minor units; 0 = no cap. Accounts may change their own.

hardStop.description: At the cap, refuse new paid lab starts (running sessions are never stopped). Off: warn only.

graceDays.description: Days after a failed payment (or a past_due/unpaid subscription) before new paid lab starts are refused.

earlyAccess.description: Early-access labs (hosted edition only): content not yet public, unlocked by a plan level. Each rule names the plan that unlocks the labs it matches (all given selectors must match; `labs` matches by id on its own); a lab needs the highest plan level among the rules it matches. Public labs match no rule and are never gated by plan. Flag a lab in its own metadata with the tag `early-access` and a rule `{ plan, tags: [early-access] }`. Self-hosted deployments do not gate labs.

plan.description: Plan id; its `level` unlocks the labs.

premium.description: Deprecated and ignored: public labs are no longer gated by plan (use `earlyAccess`). The gateway logs a warning when it is set.

plan.description: Plan id; its `level` unlocks the labs.

closing.description: The closing call to action on the landing page; the buttons default to the hero's.

socialProof.description: Customer logos and quotes. While `placeholder` is true every slot is labelled as a placeholder; never ship invented quotes as real ones.

waitlist.description: Early-access waitlist: a call-to-action section with a short form on the landing page (POST /api/public/waitlist). Entries are stored in the gateway database; no email is sent. The consent checkbox links to the privacy page (legal.privacy).

enabled.description: Show the waitlist section. Off: no form, and the gateway refuses submissions.

consentLabel.description: Text of the consent checkbox, before the link to the privacy page.

privacyLinkLabel.description: Text of the link to the privacy page inside the consent label.

errorMessage.description: Shown when the submission fails for a reason other than a field error.

fields.description: Optional fields next to the email address.

required.description: The visitor must fill it in.
The visitor must fill it in.

options.description: Choices for a select; absent means free text.

required.description: The visitor must fill it in.

external.description: Open in a new tab (defaults to true for http(s) URLs).

placeholder.description: True while the text is a draft that has not passed legal review; the page says so.

amount.description: Minor units (cents) per interval, per seat for per-seat plans.

lookupKey.description: Stripe Price lookup key; unique across plans. `stripe:sync` creates or updates the Price behind it.

entitlements.description: What a plan allows. Recorded and displayed; enforcement covers early-access labs, the free trial, payment, dunning and spend caps (docs/billing.md).

labHoursPerMonth.description: Lab session hours per month (per learner).

concurrentLabs.description: Lab sessions a learner may run at once.

envTiers.description: Environment tiers the plan may start (curriculum envTiers: A pod, B Kata pod, C VM, K kubeadm cluster, V virtual cluster, N netdev).

examSimulationsPerMonth.description: Exam simulation attempts per month (per learner).

ctfEvents.description: May join (and, for organisations, run) CTF events.

kind.description: free: no price; individual: one person, monthly or yearly; organisation: per seat, monthly or yearly.

level.description: Tier level for early-access labs (free 0). A subscriber, or a seated member of an organisation on the plan, may start labs whose early-access rules need this level or less. Default: 0 for free, 1 otherwise.

badge.description: Small label on the card, e.g. 'Most popular'.

prices.description: Required for paid plans; absent for free.

perSeat.description: Organisation plans: the price is per seat and the buyer picks a seat count.

placeholderPrices.description: This plan's prices are placeholders (also implied by `plans.placeholder`).

features.description: Premium features the plan includes on the hosted edition (docs/licensing-keys.md). Organisation features (sso, scim, audit_export, advanced_analytics, custom_branding) come from the organisation's plan; exam_certificates also from an individual plan. multi_org is a deployment feature and is ignored here.

action.description: signin: sign in or go to the dashboard; checkout: subscribe (falls back to contact while flags.checkoutEnabled is off); contact: the contact page or `to`.

figure.description: A product screenshot: the dark-theme image, an optional light-theme variant (used for the light and cream themes), alt text and the intrinsic size (reserves the space before the image loads).

image.description: Absolute path served by the web app (apps/web/public, e.g. `/site/workspace-dark.webp`, captured by apps/web/scripts/site-shots.mjs) or a URL.

imageLight.description: Variant shown in the light and cream themes; defaults to `image`.
